# World Sports Quiz

> Free sports quizzes and live fan predictions for the FIFA World Cup 2026 (June 11 – July 19, 2026; hosts: USA, Canada, Mexico; 48 teams, 104 matches). No sign-up required.

## What's here

- Prediction pages for all 104 World Cup 2026 matches, each with kick-off date, venue, group context and a live fan poll: https://worldsportsquiz.com/predict/
- Free trivia quizzes for every qualified team, star players, World Cup history and the 2026 tournament: https://worldsportsquiz.com/football/world-cup-2026/
- Interactive bracket builder: https://worldsportsquiz.com/predict/bracket/
- Pick-the-champion poll: https://worldsportsquiz.com/predict/champion/
- World Cup 2026 FAQ (dates, format, hosts, Round of 32): https://worldsportsquiz.com/faq/

## Key pages

- [Match predictions hub](https://worldsportsquiz.com/predict/): every match, grouped by date
- [Quiz hub](https://worldsportsquiz.com/football/world-cup-2026/): 70+ quizzes, 10 questions each
- [FAQ](https://worldsportsquiz.com/faq/): tournament facts in plain answers
- [Sitemap](https://worldsportsquiz.com/sitemap.xml)
